record.label: Compressed endpoint and production economics
record.summary: Endpoint accuracy and production economics remain blocked until both the collision-sidecar residual carrier B2B3C and dense autonomous stability B2B4 solve. Only then may retained gain, PSD validity, raw <1e-8, and literal total FLOPs <2^41 be tested.
record.terminal_criterion: After B2B3 and B2B4 are solved, retain the frozen preregistered fraction of dense gain, project held-out raw final-layer MSE <1e-8, prove/reset PSD validity, and pass independent static plus literal meter audits for total per-MLP FLOPs <2^41 under the exact rebuild schedule; otherwise close the compressed production spelling by accuracy, stability, or cost evidence.
